title: Plant Manager
text:
**Company Overview**

DeConna Ice Cream is a leading distributor of ice cream products, serving customers throughout Florida and surrounding states. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction drives us to deliver the finest ice cream selections to our clients.

**Position Summary**

We are hiring a Plant Manager for our Tampa location. In this role, you will oversee daily operations, including three delivery routes, the freezer crew, an office assistant, facility upkeep, and vehicle maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide excellent customer service and support day-to-day branch operations.
* Place stock orders and help ensure inventory needs are met.
* Complete cross-training in delivery, pre-sales, freezer picking, warehouse operations, and office tasks.
* Use computer systems accurately and efficiently.

**Qualifications and Expectations**

* Strong multitasking, punctuality, attention to detail, and customer service skills.
* A clear Motor Vehicle Record.
* Flexibility with start times, which vary by business need and may be as early as 4:00 a.m. on some days.
* Compensation will be discussed at the time of hire.

**How to Apply**

Please apply on Indeed. We will review your resume and contact qualified applicants.

DeConna Ice Cream is a drug-free workplace. Applicants are subject to a background check, Motor Vehicle Record review, and pre-employment drug testing.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $42,000.00 - $52,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Required to Pass a Level II Background Screening for the JLA?

Experience:

* Plant management: 1 year (Required)
* Customer service: 1 year (Required)
* Warehouse supervisor: 1 year (Required)
* Management: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Location:

* Tampa, FL 33614 (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Tampa, FL 33614 (Required)

Work Location: In person
